profiles.name: baseline-v4
profiles.notes: Default-ish NFSv4 TCP hard mount; use as the before baseline.

profiles.name: large-io-1m
profiles.notes: 1 MiB rsize/wsize for sequential large-file throughput.

profiles.name: large-io-64k
profiles.notes: 64 KiB buffers; useful on older stacks or constrained clients.

profiles.name: cache-actimeo-60
profiles.notes: Longer attribute cache for read-heavy, single-writer workloads.

profiles.name: cache-nocto
profiles.notes: Skip close-to-open consistency; only for read-mostly media libraries.

profiles.name: resilient-timeouts
profiles.notes: Higher timeo/retrans for flaky links; may not raise peak throughput.

profiles.name: nfsv3-tcp
profiles.notes: NFSv3 can be faster for simple high-throughput exports on some NAS boxes.

profiles.name: nfsv3-nolock-64k
profiles.notes: NFSv3 with mid-size I/O; compare against nfsv3-tcp and baseline-v4.
